summary_bullets: Capture Claude subprocess wall-clock rows for review, voter, phase-3, and scout roles instead of dropping them at the ledger.
Normalize Claude launcher status aliases so reports can aggregate completed Claude vendor tasks.
Cover Claude timing rows in ledger and report harnesses.
commit_message:
Record Claude subprocess timing rows

Allow Claude vendor task kinds through the timing ledger with the same warning-only allow-list behavior as Codex and Cursor, and normalize Claude launcher status aliases before writing rows.

Add active Claude review, voter, phase-3, plan/decomp, and scout task kinds to the allow-list, then cover ledger normalization plus report aggregation for Claude timing rows.
